description:
Installation and replacement of front door;
construction of a 2m high brick built boundary wall to rear and 1.2m to 2m high
brick built boundary wall to rear side; extension and replacement of rear
patio; installation of bi-fold doors to side and rear elevations; construction
of infill pergola to rear; external lighting to rear; rooflight in rear roof
slope; outbuilding to rear; hard and soft landscaping to front; 1.25M high
brick built boundary wall to front; external alterations
decision_conditions:
<p>The
proposal by reason of scale and design of the extension, proposed front and
rear boundary treatments and design of the replacement front door
shown in the marked up photograph would harm the character and appearance of
the conservation area and the special interest of the locally listed group. Furthermore, insufficient clear and convincing justification or public benefits to outweigh the
harm have been demonstrated and the proposal is contrary to the requirements of the NPPF and policies GR1 and HE1 of the Harrow Local Plan (2021-2041).</p>

Insufficient information has been provided so as to fully demonstrate the nature of the proposals (e.g. design of the extension, front door replacement, lighting, Correctly scaled plans, and hardstanding). As such, the local planning authority remains concerned that the proposals could further harm the special character and appearance of the conservation area and the special interest of the locally listed group, contrary to the requirements of the NPPF and policy HE1 of the Harrow Local Plan (2021-2041).
